## Outgoing

- depends on `bc-domain-modeling`'s contract — required, when visible-layout hybrid project.
  The shared-glossary rule for a hybrid project's root glossary.md has one home in bc-domain-modeling; planning points to it.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md)

- loads `bc-domain-modeling` — required.
  Step 3 captures terms and decisions inline during the grill.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#pipeline)

- loads `bc-grilling` — required.
  Step 1 interviews the idea before any artifact is written.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#pipeline)

- hands off to `bc-pipeline-to-done` — optional.
  Close-out recommends draining the published queue; the user decides.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#pipeline)

- loads `bc-plan-slicing` — required.
  Step 7 slices the PRD; the agent finalizes slices without an approval stop.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#pipeline)

- loads `bc-prd-drafting` — required.
  Step 4 synthesizes the PRD from the grill and the codebase.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#pipeline)

- hands off to `bc-prototype` — optional, when working a map's prototype step.
  bc-prototype is user-invoked: a prototype step gives the owner the command with the step's question and records its verdict.
  Source: [body/map-mode.md](body/map-mode.md)

- loads `bc-research` — required, when a map has research steps.
  A map's research steps are resolved with bc-research, several in parallel as subagents.
  Source: [body/map-mode.md](body/map-mode.md)

- depends on `bc-setup-project`'s contract — required, when project has a Where things go table.
  Resolves roles in the scaffolded table and writes the plan as a work item from the generated work-item template. Numbers items under its worktree numbering rule. Replans an item with a `Replanning:` line in place, superseding steps and completing its Replan notes under the work-item rules.
  Source: [CONCEPT.md](CONCEPT.md)

- depends on `bc-tdd`'s contract — required.
  Step 2 reads its test levels to find required test libraries; a builder may skip a level only on the owner's words.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md#pipeline)

- depends on `bc-teach`'s contract — required, when visible-layout hybrid project.
  In a visible-layout hybrid project the root glossary.md is shared with teach; planning edits it under bc-domain-modeling's shared-glossary rule.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md)

- loads `naming-things` — required, when choosing domain or public code names.
  Apply shared naming criteria without changing the surrounding workflow gates.
  Source: [body/SKILL.md](body/SKILL.md)

## Incoming

- incoming from [bc-code-review](../bc-code-review/RELATIONSHIPS.md): hands off to this concept — optional, when a review loop stops for replanning.
  Recommends the owner return the item to planning; bc-plan-to-pipeline's replanning path reads the Replan notes and restores readiness.
  Source: [bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md](../bc-code-review/body/SKILL.md#review-loops-when-to-stop-fixing)

- incoming from [bc-council-challenge-plan](../bc-council-challenge-plan/RELATIONSHIPS.md): hands off to this concept — required, when after the owner's answers are written into the plan.
  Slicing runs in bc-plan-to-pipeline's settled-source mode with the grill answers passed as settled; depends on that mode's name and its open-questions-only grill.
  Source: [bc-council-challenge-plan/body/SKILL.md](../bc-council-challenge-plan/body/SKILL.md)

- incoming from [bc-file-findings](../bc-file-findings/RELATIONSHIPS.md): loads this concept — required, when after the filing is committed.
  Runs bc-plan-to-pipeline from a settled source on each work-planned item it filed, passing the owner's answer and the caller's evidence as settled; a sequential handoff, not a nested call.
  Source: [bc-file-findings/body/SKILL.md](../bc-file-findings/body/SKILL.md#with-a-project-work-pipeline)

- incoming from [bc-find-bugs](../bc-find-bugs/RELATIONSHIPS.md): hands off to this concept — required, when after filing into a project work pipeline.
  Via bc-file-findings, or directly in its fallback: once its filing is committed it runs bc-plan-to-pipeline from a settled source on each work-planned item it filed, passing the owner's filing answer and the report; bc-council-find-bugs inherits this through bc-find-bugs §5.
  Source: [bc-find-bugs/body/SKILL.md](../bc-find-bugs/body/SKILL.md#5-file-after-the-owner-answers)

- incoming from [bc-improve-codebase-architecture](../bc-improve-codebase-architecture/RELATIONSHIPS.md): hands off to this concept — required, when after filing chosen findings in a project with a Where things go table.
  Via bc-file-findings, or directly in its fallback: once its filing is committed it runs bc-plan-to-pipeline from a settled source on each chosen item, passing the grilling's settled answers; a sequential handoff, not a nested call. bc-council-improve-architecture inherits this through its filing step.
  Source: [bc-improve-codebase-architecture/body/SKILL.md](../bc-improve-codebase-architecture/body/SKILL.md#4-record-every-finding-projects-with-the-table)

- incoming from [bc-pipeline-to-done](../bc-pipeline-to-done/RELATIONSHIPS.md): depends on this concept's contract — required, when project has a Where things go table.

- incoming from [bc-pipeline-to-done](../bc-pipeline-to-done/RELATIONSHIPS.md): depends on this concept's contract — optional, when the unit needs a dependency the project lacks.

- incoming from [bc-pipeline-to-done](../bc-pipeline-to-done/RELATIONSHIPS.md): depends on this concept's contract — required, when work-item source.
  Selects only items carrying the `Ready for agent: yes` line, which bc-plan-to-pipeline writes when every step states its done-criteria and out of scope.

- incoming from [bc-setup-project](../bc-setup-project/RELATIONSHIPS.md): depends on this concept's contract — required, when project has a Where things go table.
  The generated pickup rule, work-item template and work_index.py --check warning rely on the Planned: line bc-plan-to-pipeline writes once an item is planned, and on its existing-work-item settled-source mode.
